title: Erdős problem #19: chromatic number of clique unions
statement: If a graph is an edge-disjoint union of n copies of Kₙ, then its chromatic number is n.

counterexample.description: Give exactly n edge-disjoint n-cliques whose union is not n-colorable. One clique already proves chromatic number at least n, so exact failure of n-colorability proves a counterexample.
